claim_ledger.statement: The complete 23-equation, 16-parameter, three-shock nonlinear Galí source executes through target generation, surrogate fitting, likelihood evaluation, and a sampling smoke test.
The order-0 nonlinear extended-path pilot accepted 80 targets across 8 parameter paths with maximum recorded residual 9.924e-09. This is not yet a stochastic-expectations SEP validation.
The default pilot reports mean validation improvement over the ROM of 53.9 percent.
JAX and Python evaluations of the same surrogate inversion likelihood agree within 1.705e-13 at the audited calibration.

A target-corrected sampler can use fixed-reference proposal gradients and evaluate the parameter-dependent full-JAX surrogate likelihood only at trajectory endpoints without differentiating that target.
The pilot does not establish exact sampling from a full nonlinear SEP posterior because its endpoint target remains a surrogate inversion likelihood.
The pilot budgets are too small for R-hat, effective-sample-size, posterior moment, or coverage claims.
The suite lacks repeated same-work exact-baseline timings and therefore does not establish an end-to-end speedup.

hard_blockers: Independent MacroModelling.jl trajectory and likelihood comparisons.
Positive-order stochastic SEP with multiple quadrature nodes and all shocks active.
A full nonlinear likelihood or an explicitly surrogate-defined estimand.
Explicit invalid-solve support handling rather than a finite log-density plateau.
Four tuned chains with convergence and effective-sample-size diagnostics.
Posterior comparison with an exact or independently validated reference.
Multi-seed, repeated, synchronized end-to-end timing against the same-work baseline.
Galí-specific parity validation for the GPU-native QME solver; the audited Schur path uses a sequential SciPy host callback.
A clean, content-addressed software environment and revision.
